name: v8-r11-theme-resid
description: Cell R-11 (Ruling E-38 slot 50: runs only if R-6 is accepted, after R-10; parent = the last accepted cell): composition rule theme-resid-v1 (lane ORTH, task-R-11-report.md; every constant registered blind). Per decision session the parent's standardised theme composites (ew-theme-std-v1: re-ranked weighted sums of signed member ranks) are taken in the registered theme order (Ruling PM4-11: fit_composition_weights.PRIOR_THEMES, the registry order, whose first ten are frozen: value, profitability_quality, investment_issuance, earnings_momentum, price_momentum, low_risk, short_interest, reversal_seasonality, options_implied, ownership_flow; a theme registered later follows in registration order, filing_events after ownership_flow; themes with a weighted member only); the first is kept; each later one is replaced by its cross-sectional least-squares residual on an intercept and every earlier composite (an absent theme enters as 0; span tolerance 1e-10 relative: a spanned theme adds nothing that session), averaged inside each tie block of its own composite (Ruling PM4-12: names the theme does not distinguish stay tied) and re-ranked over its present names, and the blend is the sum of W_theme x that composite with the parent's theme shares; member weights, signs, tiers and the cap are the parent's. The change: fit --theme-resid theme-resid-v1 on the parent's fit argv (its --composition, screen and orientation unchanged; the fitter refuses a composition without a rerank-true theme_standardise block, so the cell is defined only on a standardised parent, i.e. R-1 accepted: ew-theme-std-v1, ew-theme-std-aim-v1, or R-10's ic-shrink-v1 / ic-shrink-aim-v1; Ruling E-45: if R-1 is rejected R-11 is skipped as undefined; Ruling E-44: an aim parent's gains stay in its weights, which theme-resid-v1 leaves unchanged); the IC w pass reads the weights file's theme_residualise block (scratch N x (8T + 8) bytes on top of the parent's admission; Ruling E-28's 3,072 MiB is inherited). Downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's. The re-fit is checked against the parent cell (finding R6B-O-5): the template derives inputs.reference_resid_parent = the parent's fit composition_weights.json (pinned by lock), which the fit step passes as --theme-resid-parent with its pin; the fitter refuses a re-fit that is not that file plus the theme_residualise block (only provenance.script_sha256 and the admission SHA it moves may differ) and records the parent's SHA-256 in provenance.resid (a child of this cell never inherits the check). Identity before the cell: the parent's w argv re-run on this build is byte-identical (flag absent). Acceptance (pre-registration rule 5 and R-1's mechanical criterion, Rulings E-44, PM4-4): paired S2 net dSR > 0 against the parent AND mechanics AND planned turnover per unit gross not higher than the parent's (the composition-cell criterion of R-1, plan 12.1).
